{{Top|leg}}
'''Espionage hardwired modules''' were used in [[espionage droid]]s such as the [[RM-2020 espionage droid]].<ref name="CFTD">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref> The modules included a complete information recording and broadcast system that allowed the RM-2020 to track enemy movements on the battlefield.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
